name: PAMReferrals
title: Referrals to blood management (PAM 9, 12)
publisher: QH FHIR Connectathon 2026 — Track 1 (synthetic, not for clinical use)
description: Patients referred to the blood management service in the measurement period, by waitlist category and surgical unit.
usage: Criteria are FHIRPath (text/fhirpath), evaluated once per patient with the context set to a Bundle of that patient's resources (as Patient/$everything would return). %periodStart and %periodEnd hold the measurement period as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Uses defineVariable() and sort() from FHIRPath 3.0 (fhirpath.js 4+). Evaluated by ../evaluate-measures.mjs; a production version would use CQL on a server with $evaluate-measure.

population.description: Patients with a referral authored in the period and a surgical waitlist entry

criteria.expression: entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '3457005').exists() and authoredOn.toDate() >= %periodStart.toDate() and authoredOn.toDate() <= %periodEnd.toDate()).exists() and entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(category.coding.where(system = 'https://aehrc.github.io/qh-connectathon/track1/CodeSystem/elective-category').exists()).exists()

entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '3457005').exists() and authoredOn.toDate() >= %periodStart.toDate() and authoredOn.toDate() <= %periodEnd.toDate()).category.coding.where(system = 'https://aehrc.github.io/qh-connectathon/track1/CodeSystem/referral-source').code.first()
